limits: Canonical discovery statuses from global-catalog-discovery.md were used; these are audit dispositions only, not production JSON.
All 20 bounded searches were issued exactly once; no result output was clipped, and no query was repeated.
Search snippets were discovery only; no product or price claims were accepted as evidence.
No official offer or product page was opened. Public terms were opened only for shop.spar.al after its robots policy was read.
Most robots endpoints were inaccessible through this reader; this was treated as unresolved access and offers pages were not opened.
No new catalog entries, prices, images, highlights, schema fields, or production changes were created.
